title: Claude Code + Obsidian: My family’s AI brain | Scott Farrar
text: Claude Code + Obsidian: My family’s AI brain | Scott Farrar Subscribe Sign in Playback speed × Share post Share post at current time Share from 0:00 0:00 / 4 Claude Code + Obsidian: My family’s AI brain | Scott Farrar 🎙️ Scott Farrar walks through the Claude Code and Obsidian system he built to track appliances, chase insurance quotes, and keep household projects moving Claire Vo Nov 11, 2026 4 Share Transcript Scott Farrar is a math educator and parent who got tired of AI chats that drift and forget. So he built a household brain in Claude Code: a folder of Markdown files, viewed in Obsidian, that knows his appliances, warranties, insurance documents, and everything on his family’s to-do list. In this episode, Scott shows how he uses it to shop for car insurance, plan repairs, share the system with his wife, and put priority tasks and recent wins on a wall display. We also talk about AI and math learning, and why he wants AI to keep kids doing the thinking.
